reason: My booking system already has an online booking button and my web person already set up the contact page. I'd have to think about why I'd pay for a chatbot on top of that, and I don't see the gap yet.
objection: If the AI gives a wrong answer about a treatment or a price, that's my name on it, and I'd have to trust it to hand over to my staff when it's unsure. I don't know that it will.
would_change_my_mind: My web person recommends it and it plugs into the booking system I already pay for, showing me real chats where it booked someone and handed off the rest.
